lines.text: @samurai is the samurai who does all the cleaning work for you. He sweeps the hall in one clean arc and folds the laundry into sharp squares.
Quick cuts, each task one strike.

new_beats.text: Every chore, done in a single stroke.

writes.note: I kept your words and added one short VO line over the shot.

reply.rationale: The VO adds a brief narrator line that echoes the single-strike idea of the shot without repeating its action. It is short enough to fit the 15 s ad.
